questions: SK Slavia Prague was founded in which year?
SK Slavia Prague: Czech professional football club in Prague.
Largest of the four by area — which one?
Gran Colombia has the greatest area of the four (3,064,800 km2).

A Victorian realist influenced by Romantic poets like Wordsworth, this English novelist and architect was highly critical of his era's treatment of rural communities, though he saw himself primarily as a poet. Who is he?
Thomas Hardy (2 June 1840 - 11 January 1928) was an English novelist, poet and architect.

Released in August 2021 through GOOD Music and Def Jam, this tenth studio album features guest appearances from The Weeknd and Lil Baby, plus uncredited verses from Jay-Z and Travis Scott — what's the album?
Donda: 2021 studio album by Kanye West.
Founder of a prominent Russian design studio and an avid, famously foul-mouthed blogger, this designer and entrepreneur is also a member of the Tolstoy family — name this designer?
Artemy Lebedev (born 13 February 1975) is a Russian designer, entrepreneur and Internet personality.

This Nazi Party official amassed enormous power as Hitler's private secretary by controlling who and what reached the Führer — and he had once served prison time as an accomplice in a murder alongside the future commandant of Auschwitz. Who was he?
Martin Bormann (17 June 1900 - 2 May 1945) was a German Nazi Party official, head of the Nazi Party Chancellery, private secretary to Adolf Hitler and war criminal.
